name: Sum of products — multiplication is inside the terms
note: The multiplications are inside the terms, already done. The last operation applied to the whole expression is addition — a sum.

name: Product containing a sum — looks like a sum
note: The $+$ is trapped inside a chunk (the bracket). The dominant operation is the multiplication outside — a product.

name: Coefficient in front of a power
note: $2x^2$ is $2 \cdot (x^2)$, not $(2x)^2$. The exponent grabs only the $x$; the dominant operation is the product of $2$ and $x^2$.

name: Expression with a leading minus
note: A leading minus is just the sign of the first term — it does not make the whole thing a subtraction. -3x + 2y is a sum. (A leading minus can also sit on a power, e.g. -(x+1)², which is a power then negated.)

name: Power containing a sum
note: The base is the whole chunk (x+1). The dominant operation is the power.

name: Quotient with a complex numerator or denominator
note: The sums are inside the chunks (numerator and denominator). The whole thing is a division — a quotient.
